title: Candidate conditional kappa 0.001018475695250068: grouped entrance capacity and shared-frame enlargement
body:
Conditional κ = **0.001018475695250068** (`254618923812517/250000000000000000`), **0.01380345% above #423**.

On our #418 word, compose #414's four grouped promotions, #420's pivot 672, #421's two full rank-two promotions, then 13 of #423's 14 entrance enlargements. Pivot 785 is not an entrance on our word and is explicitly excluded; the unadapted transfer rejects. The final construction has 215 gauges and 587 entrance instructions. The last stage changes no scalar instruction and shares the frame costs of the paired 914/960 enlargement.

Validation of the current mathematical code (`228c86d9a884dc827d90ccdadf7781ba46fb5eea`) passed:

- All 1,021 complete and retained-snapshot columns through three hash-bound stages; literal shear multiplication in the first two, unchanged operators in the third; all gauged responses zero; chronological A/B frame propagation, snapshot/final endpoints, reverted-frame and omitted-gate controls.
- Both formal scalar orientations, arbitrary dirty restoration, private erasure, chronological target bracket, 7,017 freshly recomputed response entries and 7,118 unit response macros.
- 960 new/reflected exact Gaussian phase pairs and 16 signed coefficient-word microchecks.
- Actual physical owner/padding assembly, independent decoder and eight structural controls, regenerated finite invoice, reserve bridge, two rational moment engines and all 47 strict outer inequalities.
- Fresh bit composition at this exact complex bound. All nine package manifests passed.

[18 committed receipts, including rejected transfers and failed attempts](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/abd6c8f8173497980f1f3e3da023252b2c172719/research/e8-grouped-closure/VALIDATION-LOCAL.json) contain source and compressed hashes. They also preserve earlier candidate passes separately. The preceding rank-two version's physical template write failed with `OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device`; that failure was not a mathematical assertion failure. The current enlarged word passed its own fresh physical replay after lossless archival and byte-identical archive deduplication.

**Pending:** uninterrupted replay of the complete nested parent/new wrapper and Python 3.11/3.14 CI. Component passes and fresh bit replay are not represented as a full wrapper pass. The PR remains a draft.

16 replicas; 1,465 banks per stage; 28,545 live and 29,336 physical registers. The invoice charges 16,387,872 real primitives, local bound 9,415,823,881,912, 61,920 bank-boundary adapters and row reserve 15,447 < 20,161. Complex lower: `1019514045526403509333/1000000000000000000000000`; unchanged bit lower: `255384852701747/250000000000000000`.

Run `python -B research/e8-grouped-closure/verify.py /absolute/path/to/new/output`. It freshly replays #418, all three immutable constructors, the current finite assembly and fresh bit, checking nine manifests before and after.

This uses the broader chronological/dyadic conditional framework of #418/#423. No unchanged legacy gx/gxcore E4/E5 acceptance, Lean proof or unconditional exponent is claimed. Inherited all-size window, arbitrary dirty-bank, compiler, fixed-tape, restored-row, common-grid, precision and analytic assumptions remain.

Prepared by Rohan Arun with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit eumemic #414/#420/#421 for the seven promotions, #423 for backward-capacity/shared-frame enlargements, #416/#421/#423 immutable constructors, #411 prefixes/lowering; Rohan #418/#415/#413/#409; chafreaky #419 (comparison and byte-identical #414 data retrieval) and #402; Dugongue #404/#401; #403 banks; applecrusher #376 and Sussman E8 lineage.
